# Kiwi.com Code

> > Kiwi.com's technology blog and engineering community hub covering software development, mobile engineering, data infrastructure, and security practices.

This is the technical blog and developer portal for Kiwi.com, a leading travel technology company. The site features insights from engineering experts like Kateřina Raszka, Darren Kerr, Šimon Javora, Pavel Holec, and Peter Vaňko on topics ranging from Swift/SwiftUI mobile development to BigQuery data engineering and GRC security practices.

## Key Topics

- Kiwi.com
- Software Engineering
- Mobile Development
- Swift & SwiftUI
- Data Engineering
- BigQuery
- Security & GRC
- Tech Blog
- UIKit
- Xcode
- Travel Technology
- Engineering Best Practices
- Kateřina Raszka
- Darren Kerr
- Šimon Javora
